headline: Defence sector stocks decline in Tuesday trade
summary: Shares of Apollo Micro Systems and Krishna Defence saw notable declines on October 8. Apollo Micro Systems dropped 4.24%, while Krishna Defence fell approximately 3%. This movement follows a period of high volatility in the broader defence manufacturing sector.
why_it_matters: Volatility in small-cap defence stocks may impact retail portfolio valuations.

The move involves two publicly listed entities operating in the defense and aerospace technology space. Retail investors holding shares in either company should track acceptance ratios and open offer timelines.
